notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Naga Fleshcrafter.
description:
Cast Naga Fleshcrafter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Naga Fleshcrafter into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Naga Fleshcrafter's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Naga Fleshcrafter's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Naga Fleshcrafter's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.
